items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: And this is dedicated to our eldest son and grandson, Roland.

ctx.x: Paul who? Barbra. I doubt it. Probably Nick Baraka up there.

No, I don't remember. And this is dedicated to our eldest son and grandson, Roland. March of Voice, 1955. Our prayers have been for peace and for the safety of our boy. His service in the Navy will very soon be over. Our hearts are filled with joy that he will be home again. And then that he will reach the goal he wants to gain. Wherever he may go in life, we give everlasting thanks. Not just because our boy will be home and he is safe, but for all other blessings, the training and experience to build his…
Maybe you'd like to hear that.

items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview, 1967-06-01
items.q: Roller is my favorite grandson, but he don't love them all.

ctx.x: Oh yes, give me your name. The Redder Roller 11.
You should have put that roll on. Roller is my favorite grandson, but he don't love them all. He's doing too swell to worry about his grandma now. She's the one that inspired him all the way through.
And let's see, the day is... June 1st. June 1st, 1967. And where are we?
